opening.argument: The discussion is framed as an examination of meme-coin investing, beginning with whether viewers are late and should buy, rather than presenting a specific offer. The panel then undercuts a purchase-driven reading by stating that meme coins may onboard users while being “not a suitable investment choice.” It gives a direct warning not to sell all assets and bind them to one meme coin, and treats market timing as uncertain because “no one knows.” An audience account of putting money into Pepe after hearing a positive claim, along with references to trading incentives and rugging, is presented as discussion of risks and allegations, not as a solicitation to join a scheme.
